title: IHP sg13g2 open PDK (prerun; ROM densities not calibrated)
source: ihp-sg13g2 in the pinned iic-osic-tools image; cell areas measured from its liberty files on 2026-10-25; every other value is empirical

prerunConstraint.note: Placeholder prerun die for a slice; no owner decision has set it.

ioRingWidthMm.source: sg13g2_io pads with the standard edge spacing; to be measured on a real pad ring

macAreaUm2.source: 8x4-bit MAC with a 20-bit accumulator; a sg13g2 flip-flop (52.6 um2) is 2.6x the sky130 one, so cells are larger than at sky130

flopBitAreaUm2.source: sg13g2_dfrbp_1 area 52.6176 um2 (Liberty typ_1p20V_25C, measured 2026-10-25); typ/high add enable and read multiplexing

utilization.source: typical standard-cell placement density; to be measured

powerOverhead.source: power grid share of the core area, as in the GF180MCU profile

technology.source: ihp-sg13g2 in the pinned iic-osic-tools image

calibration: not run: the ROM and SRAM densities of library-130nm are empirical (FR-EST-13)
